002-3. T/N: "History of Ming" by Sitong Wan.
002-4. I'M NOT SURE IF IT'S BECAUSE SHE THINKS OF THAT RAINY DAY WHENSHE ARRIVED, OR SHE JUST LIKES THE RAIN.

Page 003
003-1. IT RAINED ALL NIGHT AND THE TEMPERATURE SEVERELY DROPPED. DOYOU WANT TO WEAR A COAT TOO?
003-2. YEAH,IT'SA LITTLE COLD TODAY.
003-3. A COAT WITH MY SCENT ON IT.
003-4. History of Ming
003-5. DUMMY!

Page 004
004-1. ..HMPH.
004-2. 中华史
004-3. History of Ming
004-4. YOU'VE BEEN READING THE WHOLE DAY.

Page 005
005-1. IT'S RAINING SO HARD,WHAT ELSE CAN YOU DO BESIDES READING? IF YOU GO OUT,YOU'L BECOME SOAKING WET.
005-2. YOU'RE NOT ON THE COMPUTER EITHER.
005-3. IT'S RARE FOR IT TO BE RAINING, I'M GIVING MYSELF A LITTLE VACATION.
005-4. GENERALLY SPEAKING, YOU'RE SUPPOSE TO BE STUDYING DURING THE NORMAL PERIODAND PLAYING ON THE COMPUTER DURING VACATIONS, RIGHT?
005-5. YOu KNOW THAT? THENWHY DO YOU ALWAYS PLAY GAMES WHEN YOU'RE ASKED TO STUDY?
005-6. THAT'S NOT THE SAME!
005-7. SURE ENOUGH, I STILL NEED TO READ MORE BOOKSSOI DON'T GET TRICKED.
005-8. T/N: The book is a novel called "The Devotion of Suspect X" by Keigo Higashino. It has won him many awards.

Page 006
006-1. INSTEADOFTRYING TO GET NEXT TO MEAND PUTTING HER LEGS ON ME, SHE'S ACTUALLY OVER THERE READING A BOOK ALONE.
006-2. SURE ENOUGH, MY GUESS A FEW DAYS AGO WAS RIGHT, THE WARRIORESS'S IGNORANT CONSCIOUSNESS FINALLY AWAKENED.
006-3. SHE HAS ALREADY THROWNOUT THE DAILY INTIMACY BEFORE SHE EVEN FIGURED OUT HOW TO DEFILE ME!
006-4. RIGHT, LET'S TEST HER.
006-5. I SUSPECT THAT SHE TOOK THE OPPORT- UNITYTODOSOMETHING TO ME QUIETLY WHILE I WAS ASLEEP LAST NIGHT, BUT I HAVE NO PROOF.
006-6. IHADA DREAM YESTERDAY,

Page 007
007-1. THERE WAS A BIG OCTOPUS RUBBING ME WITH ITS TENTACLES.
007-2. OCTOPUS?
007-3. YES,A SUPER BIG OCTOPUS.
007-4. I BOOKMARKED A SITE FOR ZHOU GONG'S DREAM INTER- PRETATIONS, I'LL SEND IT TO YOU SO YOU CAN SEE WHAT SEEING AN OCTOPUS MEANS.
007-5. T/N: Zhou Gong is known as the"God of Dreams".
007-6. THERE'S NO NEED!
007-7. I PIPN'T GET I DIDN'T GET ANYTHING OUT OF HER IN THE END.

Page 008
008-1. READING AT THE COMPUTER DESK ISN'T COMFORTABLE, WHY NOT LIE ONTHE SOFA AND READ,IT'S VERY COMFORTABLE~
008-2. LYING DOWN AND READING HURTS THE EYES.
008-3. OKAY~
008-4. THE BOOK TALKS ABOUTAKINDOFLIKE WHERE AS LONG AS YOU THINKOF THAT PERSON. NO MATTER WHAT YOU'RE DOING AND WHETHER IF IT MATTERS OR NOT, YOU'LL FEEL HAPPY.
008-5. IS IT LIKE THAT?
008-6. HOW DO I KNOW,AREYOU HAPPY WHENYOU THINK OF ME?

Page 009
009-1. I JUST GET ANGRY.
009-2. I'M TERRIBLY SORRY ABOUT THAT THEN.
009-3. IT'S JUST A PITY THAT HE WAS LET DOWN BY THAT STUPID WOMAN IN THE END.
009-4. I REMEMBER SHE WAS RECENTLY READING "THE DEVOTION OF SUSPECT X"
009-5. SHE IS REALLY STUPID,WHAT WOULD YOU DO IF IT WAS YOU?
009-6. I'LL KILL THOSE PEOPLE AND THEN BREAK HIMOUT OF PRISON.
009-7. ..ASEXPECTED OF YOU.

Page 010
010-1. IN FACT,AS LONG AS YOU'KILL THAT PERSON AT THE BEGIN- NING, YOU WOULDNT HAVE ANYTHING TO WORRY ABOUT.
010-2. AS LONG AS YOU CARRY HIM TO THE RIVER AND KICK HIM IN,HE'LL DIE BY HIMSELF,AND IT'LL HAVE NOTHING TO DO WITH ME.
010-3. YOU'LL DEFINITELY BE CAUGHT BY SURVEIL- LANCE CAMERAS IF YOU RUN AROUND WITH HIM.
010-4. BUT THEY DIDN'T HAVE THAT IN THE HAVE THAT INTHE BOOK, THOSE PEOPLE HAD'TODRIVE AND HAD'TO DRIVE AND FOLLOW SOMEONE TO SEE WHAT THEY HAVE DONE.
010-5. I WOULD FOLLOW FROM BEHIND AND SHOOT HIMWITHA DART USING GLOVES AT THE FRONT OF HIS HOUSE.
010-6. NO, IF IT WAS YOU, NO ONE WOULD DARE TO DISTURB YOU LIKE THAT IN THE FIRST PLACE AND WOULD STAY AS FAR AS POSSIBLE. SUPPOSE YOU BROKE INTO PRISON..
010-7. .WHYARE WE TALKING ABOUT MURDER ONA RAINY NIGHT?
010-8. THEN WHAT DO YOU WANT TO TALK ABOUT?

Page 011
011-1. HOW ABOUT WE TALK ABOUT PUTTING AWAY THE STLIFFED BEAR AT NIGHT WHEN YOU GO TO SLEEP?
011-2. IF YOU'RE AFRAID OF THUINDER AT NIGHT, YOU CAN JUST HIDE IN MY ARMS, HOW NICE IS THAT~
011-3. THEN I THINK IT'S MORE INTEREST- ING TO STUDY HOW TO KILL PEOPLE.
011-4. I'M ONLY WEARING PAJAMAS AT NIGHT AND NOTHING ELSE, IF I'M SQUEEZED INTO HIS ARMS..
011-5. ABSOLUTELY NOT..!.!
